text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) detected a 4.5-hectare loss in 2023, which meets the minimum event area threshold of 0.5 hectares. The JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset corroborates this, showing the area was fully forested in 2020. The Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) forest map confirms the area was planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), with no native forest present. The loss was observed in both the 2023 and 2025 versions of the Hansen dataset, satisfying the corroboration rule.
